prior_check_record.scope: Historical pre-correction hashes and initial 35/518 passing checks, not current corrected behavior.

corrections.CF12_admissible_item_order: Compact admissible task-local item lists before interleaving; preserve this order in later candidate rounds. Partial items remain admissible for their clear units.
corrections.CF08_CF11_coverage: Unsupported selectors in summaries, documentary support or retained diagnostics prevent complete supported-ready coverage; ordinary clarification/source absence remain distinct.
corrections.CF04_restrictions: Validate registered stage/information/facet combinations independently of positive intersection; malformed restrictions block their declared owner scope with explicit diagnostics.

format_exclusion_clarification.qualified_label: Same product AND explicit cataloged bed volume; never expand to every format.
format_exclusion_clarification.unqualified_label: Product-wide across formats, for product-dependent information only.
format_exclusion_clarification.unknown_column: Keep scoped unresolved_binding; never choose a column by elimination.
format_exclusion_clarification.conflicting_or_invalid_column: Do not resolve exclusion scope from one side of a conflict or invalid unit/domain.
format_exclusion_clarification.explicit_unsupported_column: Retain known out-of-scope format; do not classify it as unknown.
format_exclusion_clarification.provenance: Record the negative catalog resolution, explicit size and original exclusion-label pointer; do not use negative labels as positive context.
format_exclusion_clarification.scope: Retain task/item ownership and exact catalog matching; no conversion or inferred numeric rule.
format_exclusion_clarification.authority: Implementation clarification under the correction request; not a new human source approval or scientific validation.

maintained_suite.environment: Existing ingestion Python plus existing integration site-packages, writable local temp and PYTHONHASHSEED=0; loopback only.

static_checks: Unchanged tracked files and pre-existing local files outside the three authorized edits
validation.boundary_fixture_note: Exact token/root branch tests use a synthetic internal counter; integration examples and post-fix reproductions use the real pinned local tokenizer.

preservation.previous_trials: No historical runner executed, previous output overwritten or source/quarantine edited; checked inventory covers tracked and pre-existing nonignored local files.

remaining_boundary: Method freeze has not been performed; a later lock must include the implementation and exclusion-scope clarification.
No new prospective benchmark, free-text interpreter, answering model or real-process applicability validation.
